chapters.title: Edge origins
chapters.short: From pixels and sensor streams to decisions on the device.
chapters.summary: Co-founded a mobility company and built its technology, from enterprise relocation platforms to machine learning running on mobile devices and Raspberry Pi.
details: Shipped YOLOv2 object detection with transfer learning and on-device inference for instant mobile cost estimation, replacing manual quotation visits.
Built LSTM anomaly detection on Raspberry Pi sensor streams for real-time edge inference and cargo damage prevention.
Built corporate portals, a vendor management system and Android/iOS apps. Scaled the company to 22 people and co-owned finance and operations.

chapters.title: Neural frontier
chapters.short: Language, vision and knowledge become working systems.
chapters.summary: Connected language models, knowledge graphs and audio-visual deep learning while engineering automated compliance pipelines.
details: Engineered compliance extraction across PDF, web, Excel, image and XML sources for all US states, using SciPy, Selenium and Airflow orchestration.
Evaluated LEGAL-BERT for contract review and built a Neo4j knowledge graph for private-equity competitive intelligence with automated entity linking.
Developed an audio-visual deep learning framework for real-time speech synthesis and video generation driven by 3D face models and one-shot learning.
chapters.outcome: Multi-format compliance extraction across all US states

chapters.title: Orbital intelligence
chapters.short: Take ML from documents and language to low Earth orbit.
chapters.summary: Owned technical direction and architecture across physics-informed ML, document intelligence, language systems and large-scale data pipelines.
details: Owned technical direction for LEO satellite orbit prediction using physics-informed ML and synthetic data generation pipelines.
Led entity resolution and sentiment-analysis R&D: RAG pipelines, deep learning entity matching and aspect-based sentiment with HuggingFace transformers.
Architected document intelligence spanning OCR, NER, dewarping and summarization. Built Tamr connectors handling terabytes across sources and a product testing framework.
chapters.outcome: Terabyte-scale connectors · ML across language, documents and satellite systems

chapters.title: Agent collective
chapters.short: Five specialized agents. One continuous workflow.
chapters.summary: Led 13 engineers shipping AI product verticals from 0→1, including a desktop sales platform and self-serve multi-agent workflows.
details: Architected a desktop sales platform with five specialized agents using existing user sessions for lead research, AI-assisted enrichment and multi-channel outreach.
Built drag-and-drop, self-serve multi-agent workflows with context engineering for task continuity. Improved sales by 25% for non-standard lead generation.
The agentic self-serve platform directly drove the company’s acquisition. Led post-acquisition integration and cloud platform migration.
chapters.outcome: 13 engineers led · 25% sales improvement for non-standard lead generation

chapters.title: Agent architect
chapters.short: Build the harness. Shape the context. Measure the behavior.
chapters.summary: Own product direction for enterprise desktop process automation, building vision-first RPA and agentic workflows for accounts payable and ERP-connected finance.
details: Architected deterministic agent workflows with dynamic context switching, guardrails and prompt-management templates, including organization-wide standards for MCP servers and tool and function calling.
Used modular agent architectures with hot-swappable model components to bring time to market from 3 months to 2 weeks and save $15K per month per customer.
Defined evaluation strategy for small vision-language and language models, including fine-tuning, benchmarking, agent tracing and LLM observability.
chapters.outcome: 3 months → 2 weeks to market · $15K/month saved per customer
